INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file, rename it, edit params.
Reference in a run file as: sensors/ARSR/my_ARSR

PARAM_DOCS.frequency_hz: Operating frequency in Hz. Default 1.3e9 (L-band) for ARSR. Low frequency = excellent weather penetration, long range, but coarse resolution.
PARAM_DOCS.rpm: 5 RPM = 12s per rotation. Slow scan, long range.
PARAM_DOCS.pd: 0.8 — lower at extreme range is expected.
